turns.text:
The Apps Script `Protection` class doesn't have an `addDomainEditor` or `addDomainEditors` method. The only domain-level control is `setDomainEdit(true)`, which allows anyone in the file owner's Workspace domain to edit unprotected ranges. That's already what the current version does, and it's the closest thing to what you're after.

If you want to grant access to specific people in your domain, the alternative is to list their emails in an array and use `addEditors(emails)`, but there's no per-domain editor API.

The current script with `setDomainEdit(true)` is the right approach. Want me to adjust anything else about it?

Replace the existing `onOpen` with this version, which adds the two new items alongside the existing ones:

```javascript
/** Adds a "Cleanup" menu to the sheet UI on open. */
function onOpen() {
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi()
    .createMenu("Cleanup")
    .addItem("Run cleanSurvey", "runCleanSurveyWithConfirm")
    .addItem("Build ThemeSummary", "buildThemeSummary")
    .addSeparator()
    .addItem("Build SatisfactionByRole", "buildSatisfactionByRole")
    .addItem("Protect SatisfactionByRole", "protectSatisfactionByRole")
    .addToUi();
}
```

The separator groups the survey cleanup and theme items above the satisfaction items. Safe to re-run since `createMenu` replaces any existing menu with the same name on each open.
